days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: The marketable fruits are ready for first picking after 54-60 days of sowing depending upon the variety.

harvest_span_days.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
harvest_span_days.note: A 90-day crop with the first picking at 54 days: 90 - 54 = 36 days of picking.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
spacing_row_cm.quote: Plough the field to fine tilth and form long channels at 1.5m apart.

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Thin the seedlings after 15 days to maintain two per pit at 0.9 m spacing.

water_need.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
water_need.quote: Irrigate the field before dibbling the seeds and thereafter once a week.
water_need.note: Rainfed or about weekly watering is read as 'low'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Sandy loam rich in organic matter with good drainage and pH range of 6.5-7.5.

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote.
